r15-protect-responses.title: Copying responses while Protected
body: **How it works today.** Copy blocking stops Ctrl+C and right-click Copy on anything you select, typing boxes included. Every **Copy button** still works, because it hands the text over directly. Pasting into Shiftbook is never blocked.

**Tickets:** clicking a ticket chip copies its number, and right-click offers the number or its link. Those always work. Only selecting a ticket's text and pressing Ctrl+C is blocked. Pasting tickets into the Tickets tray always works.

**Responses:** there is already a button for them, but it's easy to miss. It's the bare ⧉ icon at the top of the Tickets card. It lists your responses, and picking one copies it even while Protected. In Settings → Responses there's no Copy button, so selecting the text and pressing Ctrl+C is blocked there.
Here's my proposal: add a Copy button to each response in Settings, and give the Tickets card button the word **Responses** so it's easy to find.

figures.caption: Left: **Settings → Responses** with a Copy button on each one. Right: the Tickets card's button with a label, and the menu it opens.

options.value: Copy buttons in Settings, and label the Tickets button
options.why: Copy blocking stays as it is, and responses are one click away in both places.

options.value: Let Ctrl+C work anywhere on the Responses settings page
options.why: Ctrl+C works on that page. Elsewhere it's still blocked.

questions.placeholder: e.g. also a Responses item in Find

r15-protect-responses.pick: Copy buttons in Settings → Responses, and a "Responses" label on the Tickets card's button.
